left ~60%: a large sticky panel holding an isometric cutaway of white PP pipes with flowing blue water through a black-and-limestone block

thin vertical scroll-progress bar at the far left edge with a small logo mark above and rotated mono label below
card stack runs off the bottom edge, implying scroll

vertical rail with rounded elbow connectors joining each card
cards as compact four-column tables (standard, what we design to, proof, where we show it)

scroll progress bar with highlighted segment

white matte polypropylene pipes and fittings

card headers in regular sans, card body small sans

tiny mono uppercase callout labels on the render

translucent glowing water in clear pipe sections

translucent glowing blue water in pipes

t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a deep navy background. Top-left: a large light-weight sans headline and small subhead. Left 60%: a sticky panel with a steel-blue 'active state' header tab, showing an isometric cutaway of a black and limestone block with white matte polypropylene pipes and elbows carrying translucent glowing blue water, annotated with hairline leader lines, tiny mono labels and lot tags. Right: a vertical stack of warm limestone cards joined by a thin rail with rounded elbows, each a compact table of <CONTENT>. A thin scroll progress bar at the left edge. Precise, technical.
signature_idea: A sticky pipe cutaway stays in view and switches its 'active state' while standards scroll past on a rail of cards beside it.
strengths: sticky visual plus rail is a real, buildable scroll pattern for a long standards list
the cutaway shows Aquemi's actual material story (white PP, water path)
cards keep every standard, requirement and proof in the same four slots
navy, limestone and steel-blue accent palette is on-brand
progress bar gives orientation in a dense section
weaknesses: cards are dense with tiny text, close to illegible
cutaway callout labels are garbled and too small
rendered black block adds a heavy colour not in the palette
rounded card corners and rail elbows break the square-corner rule
visual and cards do not visibly link; the 'active state' does not point to a specific card
brand_fit_why: Navy, limestone and one steel-blue accent with a light headline and mono codes fit the brand, and the scroll pattern is precise, but the black render block, rounded cards and dense small type reduce calm and squareness.
